headline: Barclays plans expansion of U.S. digital bank following acquisition
summary: Following the acquisition of Best Egg, Barclays is planning to grow its U.S.-based digital bank by cross-selling banking products to its customer base.
why: Barclays is a major global financial institution offering retail, corporate, and investment banking services across international markets.

impacts.name: Barclays PLC
impacts.why: Expanding digital banking operations through cross-selling can increase customer lifetime value and fee income.
